case: Oyu Tolgoi pre-OTD-150 decision (Southwest Oyu, South Gobi, Mongolia)

facts.description: Ivanhoe Mines signed an option agreement with BHP Billiton to earn a 100% interest in the Oyu Tolgoi concession.
Approximately 109 reverse-circulation holes completed, described as producing encouraging results.
facts.source: Mining South East Europe, 'The story of the copper discovery at Oyu Tolgoi'

facts.description: 149 holes completed prior to the discovery hole; exploration funding constrained to three deep diamond holes.
facts.source: IndraStra Global, 'The Story of the Discovery of Oyu Tolgoi'

facts.description: Three deep diamond holes planned to test hypogene potential at Southern Oyu, Southwest Oyu, and Central Oyu; Southwest Oyu collar chosen with input from geologist D. Garamjav based on surface alteration/anomaly interpretation.
OTD-150 (Southwest Oyu) drilled to 590 m; 508 m interval (70-578m) averaging >1 g/t Au and 0.81% Cu, including 278 m (188-466m) at >1.0% Cu and ~1.5 g/t Au.
facts.source: Turquoise Hill Resources 'History'; Ivanhoe Mines news release 2001-07-17

facts.description: First independent resource audit (Southwest Oyu discovery zone): inferred 588 Mt at 0.53 g/t Au, 0.41% Cu (0.30% CuEq cutoff), ~10 Moz Au, ~5.3 Blb Cu.
